name: ETL Files To Redshift
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select Files as the data source.
2.  Select your added Redshift data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Click on [\+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/files/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
